scope: Changed source/docs/artifacts only, read from pinned Git objects
limitations: Six known high-confidence credential formats only; zero matches is not an exhaustive secret audit.
Whole-blob equality with companion repositories cannot rule out partial or rewritten content.
Common standing owner briefs are intentionally shared/public already; exact equality is not new private source exposure.
Runtime credentials, provider history, uncommitted files and deployment state are outside this scan.
The review does not authorize broader public disclosure or alter repository visibility.
